scope: Ten copied source-memory stores from two development tasks. One initial MCP process per side includes schema1 conversion and analyzer fingerprint recertification. Then five alternating fresh MCP processes per side and case. Each starts with empty in-process lexical cache; OS cache uncontrolled. Primary time spans Python process startup, initialize, list tools, one readable lookup of a fixed valid literal ID, wire serialization, shutdown and wait. Docker launch/cleanup is separately recorded and excluded from MCP latency. Every actual payload, supported status, source binding and numeric trace receipt must pass the existing independent validator. Retain all attempts, no retries. Report medians/ranges; consistent improvement requires separated ranges in all ten cases. No model requests or whole-agent speed claim.
